About us

Guelph Tamil Society brings Tamil families, students and friends together to celebrate our language, arts and traditions in Guelph, Ontario.

We are a not-for-profit community organization. We host cultural programs and festivals, support neighbours through charity work, and create space for youth, kids and families to grow up connected to Tamil heritage while building their lives in Canada.

Our crest joins the Tamil tiger, fish and bow with the Canadian maple leaf, which reflects who we are: rooted in Tamil culture and proudly at home in Guelph.
